mapper.select: SELECT RESERVED4, CASE WHEN #{companyCode} = 0 THEN '옥션' ELSE '지마켓' END AS TRAN_PR, COUNT(RESERVED4) AS CNT, '${tableName}' AS RESULT_TABLE FROM ${tableName} WHERE TRAN_STATUS IS NULL GROUP BY RESERVED4 ORDER BY RESERVED4 DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT RESERVED4 FROM ${tableName} WHERE TRAN_STATUS IS NULL GROUP BY RESERVED4 ) TOTAL
